description: Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures - Standardized public dictionary tracking publicly disclosed cybersecurity flaws.
Common Vulnerability Scoring System - Industry framework scoring vulnerability severity ratings from 0.0 to 10.0.
Common Weakness Enumeration - Categorization system identifying underlying software and hardware design flaws.
National Vulnerability Database - US government repository of standards-based vulnerability management data.
Static Application Security Testing - White-box security testing analyzing source code for vulnerabilities without executing it.
Dynamic Application Security Testing - Black-box testing assessing running applications from the outside for vulnerabilities.
Interactive Application Security Testing - Hybrid testing tool combining SAST and DAST methods from inside the runtime environment.
Runtime Application Self-Protection - Security technology built directly into application runtimes to block malicious inputs.
Software Bill of Materials - Formal inventory listing components, modules, and dependencies included in software.
Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing - Combined process identifying weaknesses and actively exploiting them.
Penetration Testing - Authorized simulated cyberattack against an organization to evaluate security posture.
Breach and Attack Simulation - Automated tools continuously executing simulated cyberattacks against security controls.
Free and Open-Source Software - Software distributed with open licensing allowing anyone to inspect, modify, and use code.
